name: Hennur Road
tagline: One road corridor. Several neighbourhood stories.
description: Hennur Road is a broad residential and commercial corridor running through several localities in North Bengaluru. Hennur Cross, Byrathi, Kyalasanahalli and Chikkagubbi represent different points along that search area. Apartment projects marketed under Hennur Road can have very different last-mile approaches and surrounding services.

faqs.question: How would Aaramv compare homes here?
faqs.answer: We would narrow Hennur Road to the stretch that fits your day before choosing projects. That makes the comparison more useful: the right approach road, the services you use and the home format you need. We would then explain the trade-offs between the shortlisted communities instead of treating the whole corridor as one location.
